name: Unicons Thin Line
about: Unicons Thin Line is a free, open-source icon set with 216 icons designed by Iconscout. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

faqs.q: Are Unicons Thin Line free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 216 Unicons Thin Line are open source under the Apache 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Apache 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Unicons Thin Line in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Unicons Thin Line are there?
faqs.a: There are 216 icons in the Unicons Thin Line set, designed by Iconscout. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Unicons Thin Line?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Unicons Thin Line available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
